title: Hostinger coupon for your first purchase: SONAR20 takes 20% off the first billing period
seoTitle: Hostinger coupon first time: SONAR20 gives 20% off
description: SONAR20 takes 20% off the first billing period of a Hostinger plan. See the cart math, what is covered and what is left out, and why the billing term decides how much you save.
metaDescription: For your first Hostinger purchase, use SONAR20: 20% off the first period of the plan. Renewal is charged at the list price, so pick your term first.

editorialNote: Coupon tested in the Hostinger cart. We may earn a commission from the code.

contentSections.heading: Quick answer
paragraphs: For your first Hostinger purchase, use SONAR20: 20% off the first period of the plan, taken from the campaign price too. The discount applies to a new purchase, not to renewals or standalone domains. Choose your billing term with care, because the 20% covers only the first period; the math is below.

contentSections.heading: Hostinger first-time coupon: which one to use
paragraphs: Use SONAR20. It gives 20% off the first period of a new Hostinger plan, and you paste the code into the cart's coupon field.
A code found on a coupon aggregator may not work. SONAR20 is the one we tested in the cart, and its conditions are on the [Hostinger coupon](/en/coupons/hostinger) page.

contentSections.heading: Your first order decides the term
paragraphs: The 20% covers only the first period, so the term you pick on your first order decides how many months the discount covers. A short term suits someone who wants to try the hosting first, and the renewal arrives sooner. A longer term suits someone who has already decided to stay: the 20% applies to the whole period, and renewal only arrives at the end of it.

postParagraphs: The cart also shows the renewal price below the plan. Check that amount before you choose a term, because it is what you pay when the period ends.

contentSections.heading: How much you save
paragraphs: Our math, from the cart prices in the test: on the 48-month term, the 20% takes US$ 76.70 off the total. The 20% comes off the first period of whichever term you choose, so the amount you save depends on that term.

The 20% applies to the price the cart already shows, which in our test was the [Hostinger Black Friday](/en/reviews/hostinger-black-friday) price. Campaign prices change; check the total in the order summary before you pay.

contentSections.heading: What is covered and what is left out
paragraphs: SONAR20 applies to a new purchase of hosting plans, VPS, professional email and Reach, Hostinger's email marketing tool. A standalone domain registration and the renewal of any product are left out.

contentSections.heading: And after the first order?
paragraphs: If you are already a Hostinger customer, you can still use SONAR20 when you buy a new product, but the renewal of something you already have is not covered.
The renewal price of each plan and the refund rules are in [Hostinger renewal](/en/reviews/hostinger-renewal-price-coupon-sonar20).

contentSections.heading: Where to paste the code
paragraphs: The path is the same for any plan:
bullets: Choose the plan and the period and go to the cart.
In the order summary, click “Have a coupon code?”, paste SONAR20 and apply it.
Check the discount in the total before you pay.
postParagraphs: If the discount does not show up in the summary, paste the code into the field yourself.
For what the code covers on each plan, see [how to use the Hostinger coupon](/en/reviews/hostinger-coupon-code-referral).

contentSections.heading: Frequently asked questions
bullets: Is there a Hostinger coupon for first-time buyers? Yes: SONAR20 gives 20% off the first period of a new plan.
Does SONAR20 give a discount on renewal? No. Renewal is charged at the list price, which the cart shows below the plan.
Does the coupon work on a domain? Not on a standalone domain. It applies to a new purchase of hosting, VPS, professional email and Reach.
Does the 20% last the whole time I have the plan? No. It covers the first period of the term you choose; after that, the renewal price applies.
